from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, cv2
img = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
# sample known top-face and side pixels
for name,(x,y) in {'top1':(190,45),'top2':(170,40),'side1':(150,70),'side2':(180,72),'side3':(160,75)}.items():
    print(name, img[y,x], 'b-r=', int(img[y,x,2])-int(img[y,x,0]))
# build bluish mask
b,r = img[:,:,2].astype(int), img[:,:,0].astype(int)
mask = ((b-r)>6) & (img.mean(axis=2)>28) & (img.mean(axis=2)<90)
mask = mask.astype(np.uint8)*255
mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
n,lab,stats,cent = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask,8)
idx=1+np.argmax(stats[1:,cv2.CC_STAT_AREA])
top=(lab==idx).astype(np.uint8)
ys,xs=np.nonzero(top)
print('top face bbox', xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max(),'area',top.sum())
vis=img.copy(); vis[top==1]=(255,0,0)
Image.fromarray(vis).resize((512,288),Image.NEAREST).save('.tmp/topface.png')
# rim y per column near pivot x range
for x in range(138,186,4):
    col=np.nonzero(top[:,x])[0]
    print(x, (col.min(),col.max()) if len(col) else None)
\""
